hooks.name: Post-task verification
hooks.description: After a spec task completes, run format check, lint, type check, and the unit test suite, reporting results. Non-blocking; surfaces failures for the agent to fix.

action.command: echo "== prettier check =="; npx prettier --check "src/**/*.{ts,tsx}" 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "== lint =="; npx next lint 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "== typecheck =="; npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -10; echo "== unit tests =="; npx vitest run 2>&1 | tail -8
